purpose: Typed additive literature-and-physics blind-spot inventory: obvious confounders, ignored alternatives, and cross-scale non-equivalences. Not a physical RLL fit.
source_policy: papers context not RLL execution; peer-review tier explicit; exact source links retained; no copying paper full text

promotion_conditions: Never identify same-named pressure without dimensioned micro-to-macro model
Never double count Ly-alpha AP and shared BAO vector absent valid cross covariance
Never declare w_de transition distinct from dark matter EOS or coupled quintessence without equal likelihood/prior and perturbation closure
When Omega_s0=0, report non-identifiability of transition location/width unless independent identification demonstrated
Follow existing G4 G5 G6 and C01-C09 perturbation closure without weakening them
Any source publication is context, not model execution/physical confirmation
Preserve all previous failed gates and negative evidence
